data.description: This PingOne collection contains only the requests without documentation. For the official PingOne Platform API Reference documentation, see Read User Identity Provider.
data.evaluateGuide:
Reads the authoritative identity provider associated with a PingOne user and returns its data.
Use for: inspect a user's identity provider, verify federation assignment, retrieve provider details
Not supported: changing the provider, creating providers, reading other user attributes

data.name: Delete user identities for a specified identity provider.
data.description:
Deletes all user identities linked to a specified identity provider.
The id request body property specifies the identity provider. To get the ID, call getUserProfiles and copy the provider_id value you want to use.
Required authentication scopes: user_write.
data.evaluateGuide:
Deletes all identities linked to a specified identity provider for a DocuSign user.
Use for: remove linked identity, disconnect an identity provider, clean up user identities
Not supported: adding identities, updating profiles, managing organization settings

data.name: Read User Identity Provider
data.description:
To get data on the authoritative identity provider associated with a single user resource, the GET {{apiPath}}/environments/{{envID}}/users/{{userID}}/identityProvider operation returns the identity provider data only for the user resource with the ID specified in the request URL.
📌 NOTE

When the actor is self and the `identityProvider` attribute is not included in any provided read scope (for example, `p1:read:user*`), a 403 status is returned.
